definitions.meaning: So as to cause death, mortally

quotations.old_english: Þá beóð ádwealde þe wénað þæt se man scyle deádlíce swyltan (die and have no life after death), efne swá nýten

source_text: deád-líce. Substitute: So as to cause death, mortally. v. deád&dash-uncertain;lic, I:--Deádlíce loetaliter, Wrt. Voc. ii. 52, 38. Dǽdlíce letaliter, i. mortaliter, An. Ox. 379. Þá beóð ádwealde þe wénað þæt se man scyle deádlíce swyltan (die and have no life after death), efne swá nýten, Wlfst. 5, 9.
